verdict.rationale: Intel documents an official developer SDK ecosystem (oneAPI, OpenVINO, oneDNN, PyTorch optimizations, DPC++ compatibility tool, VTune) explicitly targeted at building AI applications on Core Ultra CPUs/GPUs/NPUs, which supports 'building against official SDKs.' However, missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of using these SDKs, concrete API/quickstart documentation in the pack, and evidence of active agentic/AI-native developer workflows beyond marketing pages.
